success.description: You assume the form of a raven. Place the %8 Raven Beastform card on your character sheet. You can only use the physical characteristics and skills shown on the card, and can fly. While in beastform, you can only use spells with the Beastform trait. You resume human form when you are knocked unconscious or killed, or when the act ends or you voluntarily end the spell. The card will not recharge until the end of the act.

boon.description: You may heal 1 normal wound as you change form.

bane.description: M to all mental checks except Observation and Intuition while in beastform;
